presentation.description: Startdev is a teaching platform for developers, aiming to go beyond simple education.

contextualization.title: Understanding the requirements
contextualization.text: Startdev is a learning platform aimed at developers, with the goal of going beyond simple education. The idea is to create a strong and collaborative community, where users help each other learn together. The platform offers a gamified experience, allowing participants to accumulate points whenever they help each other, which can be exchanged for courses or discounts on new purchases within the platform.

objectives.title: Project objectives
objectives.build: Create a platform for teaching devs
objectives.bring: Bring a form of interaction between students

continuing.title: What now?
continuing.text1: My first step was to review the document with the specifications and expectations for the platform.
continuing.text2: I wrote down points of doubt, curiosities and created an interview script to talk to the client using Google Docs.
continuing.text3: During the interview, I tried to understand what he expected in terms of both business and visual aspects. I asked if he had already defined a color palette and asked for examples of websites with visual references that the client liked.

user_flow.title: User Flow
user_flow.text: Before starting to develop the wireframes, the user flow was created. This step was important to clearly map out all the steps that the user would go through within the platform. The user flow not only helped me to better understand the user's journey, but also to have a better idea of ​​the development time and the number of screens needed, allowing for more assertive planning for the next stage of the project, which is in fact the wireframe.
